name: Yurayura Q
overview: The story follows Kyūko, a high school girl who was born to a human and a fox. Although she has eight beautiful, talented older siblings, she worries about being just ordinary, and she cannot control her fox charm powers well. Her childhood friend Haru-chan tells her that he find her charming and totally adores her, but still …. The fox girl Kyūko works hard for everyone and for herself.
